area: BaseURL override, custom fetch, proxy and dumps
question: Can both adapters be redirected to a custom baseURL, can wire bodies be captured for dumps, does the AI SDK accept a custom fetch while @google/genai offers none, and can raw bodies be reached without a proxy?

parts.text: Reply with the single word ok.

customFetchHook.note: Member lists are read from the installed genai.d.ts declarations at probe time, not transcribed by hand.

parts.text: Reply with the single word ok.

rawBodyAvailability.note: doGenerate returns request.body and response.body, so an AI SDK adapter can dump the actual wire body without a proxy.

finding: Base-URL override: @google/genai was redirected (proxy path /v1beta/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite:generateContent, status 200); the AI SDK was redirected too (proxy path /v1beta/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite:generateContent, status 200), so both accept a custom baseURL. Custom fetch: only the AI SDK exposes one (makeRecordingFetch saw both directions: true). Read out of the installed @google/genai genai.d.ts at probe time, GoogleGenAIOptions declares [vertexai,project,location,apiKey,apiVersion,googleAuthOptions,httpOptions] and HttpOptions declares [baseUrl,apiVersion,headers,timeout,extraBody]; neither declares a fetch member (noFetchMember=true), so baseURL is its only interception surface. Raw bodies for dumps: the AI SDK returns request.body AND response.body directly (true), while @google/genai exposes only none (only sdkHttpResponse.responseInternal) on the response object. dumpSDKContext today writes the SDK parameter object; an AI SDK adapter would make dumps BETTER (real wire body with status/headers), not worse or equivalent.
